description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams used for filtering search parameters related to employee immigration records in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee number and immigration record number, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering employee immigration records based on employee number and record number, with allowed sorting fields.
